levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: «سمعت الصادق جعفر بن محمد ... يحدث، عن أبيه» is kept as a narrator, not imam_in_text: the chain goes on through him («عن أبيه»), and owner ruling 2 covers an Imam who ends the route.
«آبائه» is a collective relation, not identified; the saying that follows is the Prophet's, who is not a link.
The blessing after «عليهم السلام» is not part of any surface.
